subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the fourteen security- and automation-sensitive action upgrades land as one grouped update after targeted validation, or should credentialed and release-critical action families be split for independent rollout?
rationale: CI cannot fully settle changes to third-party code that runs with secrets or elevated workflow permissions, and accepting the grouped rollout versus narrower staged upgrades is an ownership decision.

options.title: Validate and land grouped
options.body: Rebase the grouped update, verify the credentialed and release-critical workflows at the exact head, and merge if those targeted checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate App-token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publication actions into independently reviewable updates if targeted proof is unavailable or a family regresses.

recommendation.title: Validate and land grouped
recommendation.body: Rebase the grouped update, verify the credentialed and release-critical workflows at the exact head, and merge if those targeted checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the affected release and CI workflow surfaces and are already connected to the PR timeline.
